description: This file defines types and methods related to resource selection in Kubernetes, including Selector and SelectorRegex structures, with functions for matching resources based on labels, annotations, and regex patterns.

classes.name: Selector
classes.description: Represents a set of resources with specific label and annotation selectors.

classes.name: SelectorRegex
classes.description: A regex-based extension of Selector for matching resources with pattern-based criteria.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Selector instance.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Selector.

methods.name: NewSelectorRegex
methods.description: Creates a new SelectorRegex based on a given Selector.

methods.name: MatchGvk
methods.description: Checks if a given Gvk matches the SelectorRegex criteria.

methods.name: MatchName
methods.description: Checks if a resource name matches the SelectorRegex pattern.

methods.name: MatchNamespace
methods.description: Checks if a namespace matches the SelectorRegex pattern.
